items.title: Outsourced Website Accessibility Acceptance Checklist
items.description: Build an evidence based accessibility review before accepting pages from an outsourced website design team.

items.title: Responsive Breakpoint Review Protocol for Outsourced Design

items.title: Design System Token Handoff for an Outsourced Team
items.description: Transfer design tokens with ownership, naming rules, implementation examples, and change control.

items.title: Website Form Validation QA for an Outsourced Build
items.description: Test labels, errors, focus, recovery, data handling, and confirmation states before accepting website forms.

items.title: Website Content Staging Governance for Outsourced Design
items.description: Keep draft, approved, staged, and published content distinct with a practical ownership record.

items.title: Analytics Event Handoff for an Outsourced Website
items.description: Define events, parameters, consent conditions, test evidence, and ownership before launch.

items.title: Website Image Rights Register for an Outsourced Project
items.description: Track image sources, licenses, usage limits, credits, crops, and replacement responsibility.

items.title: Cookie Consent Interface Review for Outsourced Design
items.description: Review consent choices for clarity, parity, accessibility, persistence, and accurate script behavior.

items.title: Website Release Rollback Plan for an Outsourced Build
items.description: Prepare release criteria, backups, decision owners, rollback triggers, and verification steps.

items.title: Website Localization QA for Outsourced Design
items.description: Check language, layout expansion, locale formats, direction, metadata, and fallback behavior.

items.title: CMS Permissions Matrix for an Outsourced Website Team
items.description: Assign the least access needed for drafting, review, publishing, administration, and emergency work.

items.title: Post Launch Defect Triage for an Outsourced Website
items.description: Create severity rules, intake evidence, ownership, response targets, and closure checks after launch.
